tei:div.tei:p: )gson bsngo ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnam pa thams cad dang*/ rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i rnam 'phrul rgya mtshos bkod pa'i zhing khams mtha' yas mu med pa na dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ lha dang drang srong bden tshig smon lam la mnga' brnyes pa thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po che ges thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ deng sbyin pa'i bdag pos lhag bsam rnam dag gis bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon/ bdag gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum bsags yod kyi rnam par dkar ba'i byed 'brel la brten nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /bstan pa'i rtsa lag gtad rabs bdun dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ 'das rjes thob pa'i paṇa grub rnam gsum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi// sham bha la'i rigs ldan chos rgyal/ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul mes dbon rnam gsum/ mkhan slob zung gcig dang ska cog zhang gsum la sogs sprul pa'i lo paṇa mkhas grub chen po bstan pa la bya ba mdzad nas chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zag pa med pa gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /da ltar bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag dang*/ byang chub sems kyi rigs yongs su sad pa la dngos sam brgyud nas sems can la sman pa'i rigs skyes bu gsum gyi lam nas don gnyis bsgrub pa la 'dun pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bzhed don 'bad med du 'grub cing sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan yun ring du brtan par gyur cig /dge 'dun ma lus pa rgyal bas gnang ba'i zas gos gnas mal gyis chog shes shing*/ chos spyod bcu dang 'brel bar brjod bya bslab pa gsum dang rjod byed sde snod gsum gyi sgrub pa la brtson zhing*/

bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thugs bskyed gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed nas rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang gnyer ba'i rten gang zhig sdom pa gsum gyis rnam par mdzes shing nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos par smin grol zab mo'i lam la rnal du 'byor pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /slob pa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag dbang po rnon po'i dbang du gyur nas dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la sogs pa tshogs lam chung ngus bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la sogs pa tshogs lam 'bring gis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la sogs pa tshogs lam chen pos bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /rnam dpyod stobs lnga la sogs pa sbyor lam bzod pa chos mchog gis bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la sogs pa mthong lam gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la sogs pa sgom lam gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo mi slob pa'i lam gyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /tshul de dag gis thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i mthu la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams su dus la bab pa'i char chu 'bad med du 'byung zhing lo tog 'bras bu'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /las ngan gyi rgyu las bskyed pa'i 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug /sad ser/ btsa' than/ 'byung ba sgang gshongs/ mi nad phyugs nad dmag 'khrugs mu ge gdon gyis gnod pa la sogs pa'i dus kyi chad pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /skye rgu thams cad la rang bzhin du mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan zhing*/

phan tshun mdza' bshes kyi sems dang ldan pas snyigs ma lnga'i rgud pa bcom ste las ngan gyi rgyu 'bras stongs nas rdzogs ldan gyi bde ba la ngang gis spyod par gyur cig /rgyal blon dang khyim bdag du ma'i tshogs rnams rang dbang gis dpal la chog shes pas bag yod du 'tsho zhing*/ mnga' 'bangs byams pas skyong ba'i 'dun pa bzang po dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /khyad par du sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs pa'i sems cad thams cad chos mthun gyi bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor gyi lus rten khyad par can thob/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa dang mjal/ mnyes pa gsum gyis bsgrub pa mthar phyin nas dbang bcu byang chub phyogs kyi chos la gnas pas rang don du chos sku mngon du byas/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mdzad nus par gyur cig /'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byung shog /phan bde 'byung ba'i sogs brjod/// /
